title: Every in-repo project.activate sender goes through one fixture helper
description:
SPIDR child B0 of task-bb844c288fb346c0856778c738b9f073, filed by architect-20a6d1eb 2026-09-05. PREREQUISITE of task-4b9c394debe94b41a80e2b46c6d55ab8 (child B), which now declares dependsOn on this row.

PURE REFACTOR. No behaviour changes, no assertion changes, no production source touched. Every existing test stays green for the SAME reason it is green today. If any assertion has to move to keep a test passing, STOP and report - that is the signal this row's premise is wrong.

WHY IT EXISTS. Child B makes the daemon mint the activation witness and REFUSE a caller-supplied one. Twelve call sites across seven files write their own `envelope("project.activate", N, { witness: ACTIVATION_WITNESS })` literal, so any correct delivery of child B reds all of them at once. Child B's owned roster (10 files) plus those consumers exceeds the 10-file plan threshold, and the delivering worker (worker-6ab7cede) correctly stopped rather than absorb them unscoped (rail 19). The alternative shape - land child B first and migrate consumers in a follow-up - would leave those files RED on the shared branch between the two landings, owned by neither row. Routing them through ONE helper first removes that window: child B then flips a single function body.

implementationPlan.description: ADD THE HELPER, in apps/daemon/src/bootstrap/bootstrap-test-fixtures.ts (660 lines; `ACTIVATION_WITNESS` is defined here at :270 and the shared `send` at :202, which is why this is the right home). Export ONE function that builds the project.activate payload — `activatePayload(overrides?: Partial<typeof ACTIVATION_WITNESS>)` — returning `{ witness: ACTIVATION_WITNESS }` when called bare, and `{ witness: { ...ACTIVATION_WITNESS, ...overrides } }` otherwise. It MERGES over the base rather than replacing, because provider-profile-resolver.test.ts:483 needs `{...ACTIVATION_WITNESS, truthClass: "OBSERVED"}` and :169 needs a whole-witness substitution. Give it a header comment saying WHY it exists: task-4b9c394debe94b41a80e2b46c6d55ab8 will change this one body so the daemon mints the witness, and every sender routes through here so that flip is a one-line change rather than a twelve-site edit. Add a fixture-level test asserting `activatePayload()` deep-equals `{ witness: ACTIVATION_WITNESS }` and that an override merges (the un-overridden members survive) rather than replacing the object.
implementationPlan.note:
HELPER LANDED + fixture-level test.

SHAPE, at bootstrap-test-fixtures.ts:283 (directly under ACTIVATION_WITNESS, above POLICY_SLICE):

  export function activatePayload(
    overrides?: Partial<Record<keyof typeof ACTIVATION_WITNESS, unknown>>,
  ): Record<string, unknown> {
    return {
      witness: overrides === undefined ? ACTIVATION_WITNESS : { ...ACTIVATION_WITNESS, ...overrides },
    };
  }

Bare/explicit-undefined yields the FROZEN BASE OBJECT ITSELF (not a copy) — literally what step 2 specified, and what `options.witness ?? ACTIVATION_WITNESS` returned. Header comment names task-4b9c394debe94b41a80e2b46c6d55ab8 as the reason the seam exists and says not to re-inline the literal.

PARAM TYPE, deviation from step 2's `Partial<typeof ACTIVATION_WITNESS>` — deliberate, recorded here. `typeof ACTIVATION_WITNESS` types every member `string`, and provider-profile-resolver.test.ts's `SeedOptions.witness` is `Record<string, unknown>`, which is NOT assignable to `Partial<{...: string}>` (unknown is not string). `Partial<Record<keyof typeof ACTIVATION_WITNESS, unknown>>` keeps the KEY-NAME check (a typo'd member is still a compile error) while accepting the existing consumer type, so step 4(a) needs no type edit in the consuming test. Behaviour identical.

FIXTURE TEST is a NEW file, apps/daemon/src/bootstrap/bootstrap-test-fixtures.test.ts, 5 arms:
  1. `activatePayload()` toEqual `{ witness: ACTIVATION_WITNESS }` (DoD 1, first half)
  2. `activatePayload(undefined)` — the EXPLICIT-undefined branch, because :169 forwards an optional field
  3. merge-not-replace (DoD 1, second half). Discriminator is Object.keys SET-EQUALITY against ACTIVATION_WITNESS's keys — a replacing helper yields ONE key and would still satisfy `witness.truthClass === "OBSERVED"`, so the key-set assertion is what makes this arm non-vacuous. Plus per-member survival pins and a full toEqual.
  4. both branches of the whole-witness substitution byte for byte — merging a COMPLETE witness over the base equals the substitution, which is the step-4(a) byte-identity proof for :169.
  5. base is not mutated and stays frozen.
